returnRoutes.T1-core-defect: return to T1; later stages cannot repair Core
returnRoutes.T2-cli-defect: return to T2; later stages cannot repair CLI
returnRoutes.T3-package-defect: return to T3 with a forward-only package subject; never rewrite historical version bytes
returnRoutes.T4-harness-defect: return to T4; do not relabel old evidence
returnRoutes.T5-integration-defect: return to the owning T1-T5 stage before S1; after S1 create a new forward-only subject
returnRoutes.T6-assurance-finding: fail without repair and return to a new forward subject at the owning technical stage
returnRoutes.T7-reject-or-stop: terminate the campaign with no activation
returnRoutes.accepted-semantic-input-defect: STOP and create a new forward-only semantic-contract campaign; never edit A133/B133/O133
returnRoutes.baseline-or-procedure-collision: return to T0 for a reviewed additive governance amendment

stopConditions: source-tree or .git dependency in installed subject
pre-commit canonical writes on failed path
terminalBoundary: STOP after T7 O1; activation, closure, archive, release, publication, push, and provider execution remain separate future campaigns.
